questions.learningObjective: Explain mean imputation's effect on variance
questions.stem: Explain why mean imputation tends to underestimate the variance of a column.

answer.exemplar: Mean imputation places every missing value at the centre, which removes the spread those values would have contributed and shrinks the overall variance.
